disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by an API error (HTTP 400) in the qwen model when attempting to audit the .gitignore file, forcing an 'inconclusive' overall result. The deepseek model successfully audited the same file and correctly identified it as safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit .gitignore due to an API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError), resulting in an inconclusive package verdict.
learnings: API errors on trivial, non-executable files (like .gitignore) should not fail the entire audit; the tool should either retry, skip the file, or override the inconclusive status if the file is known to be benign.
Consider bypassing LLM API calls for standard configuration files like .gitignore to reduce costs and avoid unnecessary API failures.
